title: letter_bridge: 31 of 61 puzzles are unguessable
detail: Rule is word1+bridge=word and bridge+word2=word. 31/61 fail, e.g. SUN+OWN+D -> SUND/YLE. The file still carries 30 abandoned '// ... No.' working comments.
fix: Rebuild the table from assets/chain_words.txt + assets/find_word_words.txt, or delete the 31 broken rows. Delete the abandoned comments.
verify: test/engines/letter_bridge_engine_test.dart asserts for every entry that (first+bridge) and (bridge+second) are both in the dictionary. Fails before, passes after.

title: word_ladder: GOOD->EVIL puzzle is impossible
detail: EVIL has zero one-letter neighbours in the game's own 3894-word dictionary; BFS from GOOD reaches 3762 words and EVIL is in a component of size 1. Line ~3934.
fix: Delete the row. Also purge 7 non-words (BLDG BLVD FTPS PSST PWNS TBSP XXXV) and normalise or drop the 6 accented entries the A-Z keyboard cannot emit.
verify: Test runs BFS over every start->end pair using the same dictionary and fails on any unreachable pair; assert keyboard alphabet covers every dictionary entry.

title: pangram_sprint: 1 of 5 boards can never be won
detail: Win is letters.length == 26. 'How vexingly quick balthazar bolden jumps gazing' has 25 distinct letters (no f). PangramSprintEngine.isPangram exists and is never called.
fix: Replace the board. Call isPangram as a filter in getRandomTask so a bad row cannot ship.
verify: Test asserts isPangram(task.sentence) for every task; a deliberately bad row fails it.

title: lighthouses: the hardcoded fallback board has 0 solutions
detail: generateLevel returns a fixed 5x5 clue grid after 200 failed attempts. Under the game's own no-touch rule that board has zero solutions (exhaustive search over its 20 free cells).
fix: Compute the fallback with the solver and assert it, or retry with a relaxed target instead of returning a constant.
verify: test/engines/lighthouses_engine_test.dart: 200 generated boards are unique AND solver-completable; the fallback path is exercised and must be playable.

title: nonogram: no uniqueness check, ~20% of 8x8 boards have several solutions
detail: generatePuzzle plants random cells and derives clues; nothing counts solutions. 8/40 boards were ambiguous by brute force over the row-pattern cross-product.
fix: Port the propose -> countSolutions -> ship-only-if-1 pattern using lib/core/deduction.dart. Write the DeductionModel wrapper for a line-of-clues puzzle.
verify: test/engines/nonogram_engine_test.dart: 200 boards across 3 sizes, all exactly 1 solution.

title: rhyme_master: 8 of 56 given words do not rhyme
detail: LIGHT:WHITE; BLUE:VIEW,NEW,TWO,ZOO; COOL:RULE,FUEL,MULE. isRhyme only checks list membership, so the game confidently accepts a wrong answer.
fix: Replace the non-rhymes. If a set cannot be filled honestly, drop it (4 clean sets: CAT, PLAY, SING, BOLD).
verify: Test compares phoneme tails of target vs every entry and fails on any mismatch.

title: chalk_and_talk: the auditory premise is false; the app has no audio at all
detail: Screen shows YOU HEAR: "CAT" but pubspec has no audio/TTS/sound dep; grep for SystemSound|audioplayers|just_audio|flutter_tts|soundpool across lib returns 0 hits. The game is Stroop-by-subtitle.
fix: One of three, needs a human call: (a) ship flutter_tts or ~20 bundled clips; (b) re-frame the copy as a visual interference task; (c) retire the game. dual_coding already encodes pitch as haptics and is an honest precedent.
verify: If (a): a test that the audio asset/provider is wired and the word set is non-empty. If (b): copy review + no 'you hear' string remains. If (c): registry, guides, store count all updated.

title: crossword: longest word is 6, boards are 7-10 wide, placer stalls at 8 words
detail: 1535 clues: 315x3, 848x4, 358x5, 14x6, nothing longer. Placement rules replayed in Python place 6-8 words on 7x7 and 10-11 on 10x10, where the code wants 15. 13 duplicate words, 8 duplicate clues.
fix: Add 7-12 letter words and clues to the JSON; de-duplicate; make the placer report its count and retry when below the board's expectation.
verify: Test: for each board size, generate 20 boards and assert placed-word count >= board size - 1, and assert no duplicate word or clue in the asset.

title: word_search: 5 boards before every word repeats, and 16 words are unreachable
detail: 105 words; filter len 4..8 leaves 89; 15 per board -> 5 boards. 16 words of 9-10 letters can never be used. 'SEA SHELL' contains a space.
fix: Raise the filter to 10 and confirm the generator handles it; fix or drop 'SEA SHELL'; grow the list to a few hundred words.
verify: Test: usable pool (after the filter) >= 300 words and >= 20 boards' worth; no entry with a space or non A-Z character.

title: find_word / word_scramble / missing_vowels: 74% of the target dictionary is obscure
detail: 14855 five-letter words, 74% not in a standard word list. First ten a player can be handed: aahed aalii aapas aargh aarti abaca abaci aback abacs abaft. Six have no vowel.
fix: Split the asset: find_word_answers.txt (curated ~2-3k common words) for targets, find_word_valid.txt (full list) for guess validation.
verify: Test: every answer is in the curated list; the validator accepts all 24 sample everyday words; no answer contains a non A-Z character.

title: typing_speed: 8 sentences, one of them a developer placeholder
detail: 8 phrases; 'FLUTTER IS A POWERFUL FRAMEWORK FOR APPS' is dev filler shipped to players.
fix: Remove the Flutter sentence and grow to >= 40 varied phrases (lengths 20-70 chars).
verify: Test: >= 40 phrases, none mentions Flutter/Dart/developer tooling, no duplicates.

title: one_letter_shift: the stated rule is false for 24 of 26 puzzles
detail: Subtitle says 'Transform one word into another with one letter change', but 24 of 26 pairs are not: only BREAD->TREAD and TRAIN->BRAIN are true one-letter changes. Two are pure rotations (EARTH->HEART, SWING->WINGS) and 22 are plain rearrangements (HEART->STARE differs in 3 positions, PLANE->LEARN in 4, STORE->OTHER in 4). Two rows carry abandoned '// No,' working notes (STORE->ROSET 'No, ROSETTE?', SWING->WINGS 'No, 5 to 5.'), ROSET is Scrabble-only, and the SWING row is written with a different field order (start, hint, end) so a parser that assumes one order drops it.
fix: Decide what the game is. Either make every pair a true one-letter change (then the subtitle is honest), or rename and rewrite the subtitle as a letter-rearrangement game. Delete the two abandoned comments, replace ROSET, normalise the field order.
verify: Test: every pair satisfies the rule the subtitle states; every row parses with one field order; no row contains a '//' comment; no target is missing from a standard word list.

title: Six games have no guide and never get a rules page
detail: 307 guide keys for 313 games. Missing: cube, inertia, map, netslide, same_game, signpost. The info button falls back to a generic dialog whose detailedRules map has 17 entries, none of these. launchGame only shows rules when a guide exists, and marks seen anyway.
fix: Write the six entries. Note the file header claims auto-generated and the generator is gone (guide/ deleted) - either restore it or correct the header. Say in the map guide that any valid colouring wins.
verify: Test: every registry id has a gameGuides entry, and no orphan guide key exists.

title: 56 English keys missing from all 21 non-English locales (de: 72)
detail: en has 1823 non-@ keys, every other locale 1767, de 1753. The 56 are titles/subtitles/win text/how-to-play/HUD for cube, map, inertia, netslide, signpost, same_game, magnets, dominosa, skyscrapers, futoshiki, tents_and_trees, lights_out. There are 22 non-English locales (23 .arb files including en).
fix: Translate the 56 keys into all 22 non-English locales plus the 16 extra de needs. Keep placeholders identical.
verify: Test: for every locale, the key set equals the en key set (minus @@locale), and every placeholder name in a translated string appears in the en string.

title: Four games share a title and screen->game resolution is by localised title
detail: Collisions: en silhouette_match/silhouette_match_ortho, en word_ladder/word_ladder_step, pt+es color_match/color_word_match_up, de perspective_taking/perspective_shift_view. GameScaffold resolves to the first registry match, so the wrong guide and assists load, and GameClock starts under the wrong id - completeGame then finds no clock and records no time.
fix: Pass the game id into GameScaffold (or an inherited widget) and resolve on id. Do not rely on copy changes; they break on the next translation.
verify: Test: for every registry id, GameScaffold resolves to that exact id; a widget test opens silhouette_match and asserts completeGame records a time (GameClock.start/stop round-trip).

title: Guides are English-only and have no localisation mechanism
detail: 307 English guides in Dart literals across 23 locales; none goes through .arb. 22 non-ASCII lines exist and all are maths symbols, i.e. authored once and never touched.
fix: Decide and record one: (a) move guides to .arb; (b) accept English guides and say so in the store copy; (c) translate objective + controls only (recommended).
verify: The decision is in ROADMAP.md with the reasoning; if (c), a test asserts objective and controls exist for every guide and the rest stays English by design.

title: de carries 2 keys en does not have, so they can never be shown
detail: app_de.arb has kurodokoWinTitle and kurodokoWinMessage; app_en.arb has neither. flutter gen-l10n generates from app_en.arb only, so those two German strings are unreachable. Every other locale is a strict subset of en.
fix: Either add the pair to app_en.arb and all 22 locales, or delete the two German orphans. Pick one and make the key sets identical everywhere.
verify: Test: for every locale, the non-@ key set is a subset of the en key set (no orphans), and the en key set minus each locale's equals the known missing list.

title: 215 of 313 games have no difficulty control; the classics are frozen at one size
detail: Only 18 games have a difficulty mechanism (16 Tatham ports + counting_sheep + mental_calendar, and mental_calendar exposes no picker). Frozen sizes: masyu 4, hitori/nurikabe/fillomino/lighthouses/heyawake/tapa/yajilin 5, shikaku 6, nonogram 8, sudoku 35 clues, minesweeper 10x8/12 mines. The generators already take the size parameter and are never called with anything but the default. Note heyawake, tapa and yajilin keep state in the screen, not a provider (no *_provider.dart exists for them) - reach for the screen when wiring a size.
fix: Phase 1: shared DifficultyChips widget, wire size into the five puzzles that already accept one. Phase 2: 3-tier ladder per classic (masyu 4/6/8, shikaku 6/8/10, nonogram 5/8/12 gated on uniqueness, minesweeper 8x8/12, 12x10/25, 16x12/45). Phase 3: sudoku tiers as clue counts 45/35/28 gated on solvingLevel.
verify: Test per game: each tier generates, each tier is unique, and hard is measurably deeper than easy (board size or solvingLevel), not just bigger.

title: Chosen difficulty is never remembered across launches
detail: grep for difficulty in lib/data and lib/providers returns only guide prose. Every game resets to its default tier on restart.
fix: Store the chosen tier per game in the existing game_stats Hive box beside hasSeen.
verify: Test: set tier, dispose, rebuild, tier is restored; a fresh install reads the default.

title: Solve/hint covers 20 games; word games with a checkable next step have none
detail: 20 case arms; the 19 PuzzleBoard games are covered plus akari. word_ladder, letter_bridge, find_word, word_search, word_wheel have a provable next step and no hint.
fix: Audit which non-board games can produce a provable hint and wire them into gameAssistFor. Document the deliberate exclusions in docs/PLAYABILITY-AUDIT.md.
verify: Test: every wired game's hint provably advances toward a win state (the solve_button_test pattern).

title: Daily Pick is not the same for everyone and streaks by category
detail: dailyPick seeds on the date and indexes registry order, which is grouped by category: over the next 120 days the draw contains runs of 23 consecutive MATH days, 16 MEMORY, 12 MATH. It is also called with exclude: hiddenSet, so the pool shrinks per player and 'same for everyone' is false as soon as anyone hides a game.
fix: Seed a stable shuffled order (or hash the id) instead of relying on registry order, and draw from the full registry so the daily is genuinely shared. Keep the hidden-set exclusion only for the card display, not the selection.
verify: Test: dailyPick(day) is identical for two players with different hidden sets; over 120 days no category appears more than 3 days consecutively.

title: The reel has no curation: feedBlocklist ships empty
detail: feedBlocklist is an empty set with 'Paste the curation list here'. Shuffle, Daily Pick, Quick Play fallback and randomGame serve all 313 games, including the 38 one-answer games and the 113 untested ones. test/curation_test.dart validates a list that does not exist.
fix: A human supplies the list (memory: 'Gus judges the puzzles, not me'). Wiring is already done; pasting ids is a one-file change.
verify: The existing curation_test passes and the reel pool excludes every blocked id.

title: Quick Play is 12 games out of 313
detail: _quickPlayIds lists 12 valid ids; 'under 2 min' is promised by 4% of the catalog.
fix: Extend to the one-answer games (job one-answer-games) and any game with a known short session; target 40+ ids.
verify: Test: every id exists, the list has >= 40 entries, and no listed game is a long-session board.

title: Nothing records which puzzles a player has finished
detail: game_stats records solves and times per game, never which puzzle in a pool. Pools repeat with no signal; a player cannot tell they have seen everything.
fix: Record a per-game set of completed puzzle keys (cheap, hashed) and let pools prefer unseen.
verify: Test: after solving, the key is recorded and the pool prefers unseen entries; the box survives a restart.

title: 3 Semantics in the whole app and none in a game; 150 CustomPaint boards are opaque
detail: grep for 'Semantics(' across lib returns 3 occurrences, all in lib/widgets/tangible.dart (button labels). 0 of 313 game directories mention Semantics or semanticLabel. DesignSystem.semanticLabel (lib/utils/design_system.dart:201) is defined and never called. 50 screen files paint a CustomPaint board (150 CustomPaint sites) with no semantics. docs/GAME_DEV_GUIDE.md:275 asks contributors for semantics the codebase lacks.
fix: Add board-level Semantics to PuzzleBoardView (game + state summary), then per-cell labels for the 19 board games or a documented, per-game text alternative for drag-only boards.
verify: Test: a semantics test on PuzzleBoardView finds a board label and per-cell labels for the 19 board games; TalkBack walkthrough recorded in the PR.

title: Play listing has no phone screenshots at all
detail: images/ holds icon.png and featureGraphic.png and no phoneScreenshots/ directory. RELEASE.md points at screenshots/aso-refresh/final/play|ios|framed and screenshots/raw - all missing; screenshots/ holds only README.md. Play requires >= 2 phone screenshots.
fix: Run tool/screenshots.sh on a device, compose with tool/compose_house_style.py, land 8 shots at 1080x1920 in phoneScreenshots/. Fix the RELEASE.md paths to match reality.
verify: phoneScreenshots/1..8.png exist, are 1080x1920, no alpha, and RELEASE.md paths all resolve.

title: iOS has no store metadata in the repo at all
detail: metadata/ has android/ only. No ios/ directory, no listing text, no screenshots, no Deliverfile. RELEASE.md:124 says iOS ships with the same version and copy.
fix: Add fastlane/metadata/ios/en-US/ with description, keywords, promotional text, support and privacy URLs, plus 1290x2796 screenshots from the same capture run.
verify: fastlane deliver --skip_binary_upload validates the metadata without error.

title: shorebird.yaml has a stale app id and the updater is not a dependency
detail: app_id bf46de55-... predates the rename; shorebird_code_push is not in pubspec; no build bundles the updater. Content fixes in band 2 are exactly what OTA is for.
fix: Either finish it (new app id, add the dependency, a release channel) or delete the file. An inert config with a stale id is worse than none.
verify: If kept: a build reports its shorebird release id and a patch reaches it. If deleted: no reference to shorebird remains.

title: The paywall is decided and not built
detail: Decided 2026-11-11: every puzzle playable once, some free forever, gate replays and volume, never first contact. No in_app_purchase or purchases_flutter dependency exists.
fix: Build to the decision, or record that it is deferred. Do not re-decide it.
verify: A test asserts no locked game is ever served to a player who has not opened it, once built.

title: The number 313 is hardcoded in five files with no check
detail: 313 appears in README:3, the Play title, the Play full description, docs/index.html:7,28 and the web manifest. Adding or removing a game means editing all five by hand.
fix: Add a test asserting the registry length equals the number in those files, and prefer a single generated constant where the platform allows it.
